prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it has been reliably confirmed that the student has passed all remaining subjects of the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits for obtaining the Degree title, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity to integrate all general and specific competences within the scope of the completed Degree studies.

The specific learning outcomes of the end-of-degree project will vary depending on the theme assigned by the tutor but, as a general rule, will be directly related to the specific objectives of the degree.

These results will be reflected in the individual or group completion of the work, presentation and individual defense before a university tribunal of an original project in the field of Engineering of a professional nature, and in which all acquired competences are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: The contents of the End-of-Degree Project carried out by each student individually will be framed within one of the work topics within the area of Engineering in which they have pursued their studies, as indicated in the objectives of each degree.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's face-to-face activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate with it

assessment_rules: The End-of-Degree Project must be presented and defended before a university tribunal. The evaluation will generally consider the monitoring of the student's face-to-face activities by their academic tutor, the final document presented by the student, and the public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate. The final definition of the evaluation system will be adjusted to the regulations defined in the End-of-Degree Project Regulations of the School of Engineering. Both ordinary and extraordinary evaluation are carried out through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors.
